doors.note: Configured page. Static HTML holds no events — the calendar is an Elfsight widget (<div class="elfsight-app-e5a158fb-806e-4349-9a16-7546cf9cd113">, platform.js), read by collectElfsightCalendarEvents.

doors.truthFlag: the boot payload carries the widget's entire event list: 255 entries, past and future, no paging
doors.note: Elfsight event-calendar app. Entries: name, start/end { date, time }, timeZone per entry, repeatPeriod (noRepeat 220, nthDayInMonth 21, custom 13, lastDayInMonth 1), repeat* fields, description, coverImage, actions (link buttons), isAllDay. No venue field: the widget is the bar's own calendar.

recon.notes: Recon from one cached read of each door on 2026-09-19. 255 widget entries: 37 future singles, 22 repeating entries with a window occurrence, 194 entries already over (counted, not enumerated), 0 repeating entries with nothing in the window.

coverage.basis: Feed door: the Elfsight boot payload lists every entry the widget renders (255). Documented: every entry that is upcoming (37 singles) or repeats into the window (22 series, occurrences by rule). 194 entries ended before 2026-09-19 and are counted as past listings. The page's own HTML carries none of this.
